finalText:
**Drafted 4.2.0 into [CHANGELOG.md:3](CHANGELOG.md:3).** 380 commits, about 25 matter.

Three breaking items. Error types stopped being re-exported. The `v1` export route is gone. Expired tokens now return `401`, not `403`. None were tagged breaking, so check the last two are intended.

One feature. Webhook retries with backoff. I put the `perf` work under `Added` since users feel it. Move it if you disagree.

The `docs: note the minimum node version` commits touch docs only. No `engines` change. So I claimed no Node bump.
